tool_description: Initialize one persistent owner-scoped Collection Memory container in Main or one ordinary Collection subfolder.
Provide a Collection Name and Collection Description or Purpose. If folder is omitted, GHOST creates the Collection in Main.
Initialization never creates directly in Archive and does not append the current conversation automatically.
server_instruction: When the user explicitly asks to create or initialize Collection Memory, call ghost_memory_collection_init with the exact user-approved Collection Name and a clear Collection Description or Purpose. Supply folder only when the user explicitly chose an ordinary Collection folder; otherwise omit it so Main is used.
Do not create a new Collection directly in Archive. After a successful call, report the returned stable Collection ID, Collection Name, folder, and creation time.

field_descriptions.collection_name: The user-defined exact name of the new Collection within the authenticated owner's scope.
field_descriptions.collection_description: The fixed subject, purpose, or scope that the Collection will accumulate over time.
field_descriptions.folder: Optional safe relative ordinary Collection folder. Omit it for Main. Archive is reserved and cannot be used for initialization.
